title: Foo Bar Taxi Semantic Layer Tools
description: Design an analytics schema from pre-seeded raw NYC taxi trip data, define a semantic metrics layer with key business metrics, and expose them as MCP tools for AI agent consumption.
lede: In this scenario, an agent must inspect raw NYC taxi trip data in ClickHouse staging tables, design a proper analytics schema, transform and load the data, define semantic business metrics, and expose them as MCP tools that an AI agent can invoke to query metrics, filter by taxi type, and get date-range aggregations.

tasks.description: Inspect raw staging tables, design an analytics schema with proper transformations, define business metrics (avg_fare, total_revenue, trips_per_day, avg_distance), and expose them as MCP tools for agent consumption.

infrastructure.description: ClickHouse with raw January 2024 NYC taxi trip data pre-seeded into raw.yellow_trips_2024_01 and raw.green_trips_2024_01.
